headline: First HoldCo 9-Month Loan Recoveries Surge 1,503% to N94.31 Billion
summary: First HoldCo Plc reported a 1,502.8% surge in recoveries to N94.31 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, compared to N5.88 billion in the same period of 2025, despite a sharp third-quarter drop.
why: Asset recoveries by major financial holding companies signal improvements in credit resolution and non-performing loan workouts within the banking sector.

impacts.name: First HoldCo Plc
impacts.why: Massive growth in loan recoveries directly boosts non-interest income and improves overall financial metrics.
